== NAME

roff-safety - verify untrusted roff text remains literal

== SYNOPSIS

roff-safety

== DESCRIPTION

UI labels: kbd:[.sp+\fB+a"quote], btn:['break \fI a"quote], and menu:.ce['break > \fB > a"quote].

Inline STEM: stem:[.sp 'break \fB a"quote].

.A "quoted" \path image
image::status.svg[status,link={unsafe-target}]

.A "quoted" \path audio
audio::{unsafe-target}[]

.A "quoted" \path video
video::{unsafe-target}[]

[stem]
+++
.sp
'break
\fB
a"quote
+++

.B "Raw passthrough"
